measurementMethod: The frame is the t=1.0s PNG extracted from the creative_assets copy of Luke Dean - UGC 1.mp4 (720x1280, HEVC). The caption is already burned into that file; there is no uncaptioned plate, so the check compares glyph masks rather than frames. box is the white-glyph bounds (luma >= 175, x 198-512, y 385-525) padded by 8px. Both the reference crop and a caption rendered alone on black are thresholded at lumaMin, then scored with SSIM and overlap inside the box. The lines are the reference's own breaks, which have no full stop after Birthday.
